description: Enrich ONE field for up to 25 people in one call: the same lookup as the single-person enrichment for each person, run on Nock's side 5 at a time, so a list does not wait for one person after another (a mobile can take over a minute a person, so 10 mobiles take about 2 to 3 minutes and 25 about 6). results has one entry per person, in the order sent (index), each with the same fields as the single-person enrichment: person (whose it is), status found/not_found/error, value, phoneOwner, phonesDiscarded, creditsCharged, savedIn, savedTo, sourcesUnanswered (not_found while some sources did not answer in time: that person may be tried again later; error only when no source answered). Each value belongs to the person named in its entry. Only found values are charged, each at the field's price; creditsCharged at the top is the sum. The same person sent twice is looked up once (sameAsIndex, creditsCharged 0).

people.description: The people to look up, each with the same inputs as a single-person enrichment (name, company, LinkedIn, e-mail, prospectId or sheetId and rowId...).

location.description: Person location hint used to reject off-country phones.

personalEmail.description: Personal/webmail address used by phone finders.

prospectId.description: The campaign prospect this lookup is for, when known: a mobile found is saved to them.

rowId.description: The sheet row this lookup is for, with sheetId: a mobile found is saved to its phone column.

sheetId.description: The people sheet of the row this lookup is for, with rowId.

providerOrder.description: Optional exact provider cascade. Every name must belong to the selected field. Omit it to use the field's configured cost-conscious order.

refresh.description: Only for an explicit request to look it up outside again: skips what this workspace has saved.

name: enrich_field_batch
title: Enriquecer campo de várias pessoas
